rca_of_the_issue: Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in onboarding_engine.py. When creating new onboarding progress, the insert_one() operation adds an _id field to the dict, which was then returned causing serialization errors. Fixed by adding progress.pop('_id', None) after insert_one() calls.
